mapper.select: SELECT id, enabled, ban_enabled, ban_threshold, ban_window_value, ban_window_unit, limit_change_enabled, limit_poll_interval_minutes, limit_change_enabled_at, updated_at FROM ad_alert_config WHERE id = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT id, recipient_type, recipient_key, recipient_name FROM ad_alert_recipient WHERE deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY id
SELECT phone FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 1 AND deleted_at = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE ad_alert_config SET enabled = #{request.enabled}, ban_enabled = #{request.banEnabled}, ban_threshold = #{request.banThreshold}, ban_window_value = #{request.banWindowValue}, ban_window_unit = #{request.banWindowUnit}, limit_change_enabled = #{request.limitChangeEnabled}, limit_poll_interval_minutes = #{limitPollIntervalMinutes}, limit_change_enabled_at = #{limitChangeEnabledAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = 1 AND deleted_at = 0
UPDATE ad_alert_recipient SET deleted_at = UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000 WHERE deleted_at = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_alert_recipient (recipient_type, recipient_key, recipient_name) VALUES (#{recipientType}, #{recipientKey}, #{recipientName})

INSERT IGNORE INTO ad_alert_notification (alert_type, dedupe_key, title, content, account_id, account_name, trigger_value, threshold_value, currency, source_event_id, occurred_at) VALUES (#{alertType}, #{dedupeKey}, #{title}, #{content}, #{accountId}, #{accountName}, #{triggerValue}, #{thresholdValue}, #{currency}, #{sourceEventId}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM ad_alert_notification WHERE dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ad_alert_delivery (notification_id, recipient_type, recipient_key, recipient_name, delivery_status, error_message, delivered_at) VALUES (#{notificationId}, #{recipientType}, #{recipientKey}, #{recipientName}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{errorMessage}, #{deliveredAt})
